extracted.intended_audience: prospective applicants to the Branco Weiss Fellowship (2026 intake)
extracted.subtask_description: Timeline and procedural milestones for applying to and being selected for the Branco Weiss Fellowship 2026 intake, including deadlines, notifications, interview schedule, evaluators, and fellowship start window.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal evaluation stakeholders
rubrics_metrics.description: The proposals are evaluated by the directorate, selected faculty members of ETH Zurich, and external reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Short‑listing and interview requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Short‑listed candidates are invited for personal interviews, to be held in Zurich, Switzerland.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short‑listing is required to advance to the interview stage; interviews are in person (Zurich).

rubrics_metrics.name: Final application deadline (online form)
rubrics_metrics.description: January 15, 2026, 5 p.m. CET: final deadline for applications via the online form
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All applications must be submitted through the online form by this deadline (CET).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification timing for interviews and rejections
rubrics_metrics.description: May 2026: notification and invitation for a personal interview sent to final selection of candidates; notification sent to candidates whose application has been rejected
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should expect to receive either an interview invitation or a rejection notice in May 2026.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interview timing and format (panel)
rubrics_metrics.description: June 2026: candidates interviewed by a panel in Zurich, Switzerland; final selection of fellows
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interviews are panel interviews conducted in June 2026 in Zurich and are used to make the final fellow selections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowship commencement window
rubrics_metrics.description: October 1 to December 31, 2026: fellows commence research projects
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selected fellows are expected to start their research projects within this date range.
